title.narrative: Local Infrastructure in Rural Anbar, Iraq

description.narrative: The objective of the Local Infrastructure in Rural Anbar Project, is to improve basic living conditions for returnees in rural areas of Al-Anbar governorate through the rehabilitation of housing units and restoration of decentralised services in an integrated, area-based approach. The decentralised services component will entail the provision of solar street lighting, the rehabilitation of selected community roads, and of water and sanitation networks and/or stations.
